title: Wavy Edge Transparent Shockproof Pastel Cover
description:
Upgrade your iPhone with the Wavy Edge Transparent Case – a perfect mix of style, protection, and elegance. Designed with soft pastel bumpers and a crystal-clear back, this case highlights your phone’s original design while keeping it safe from everyday drops, scratches, and dust. The raised wavy edges add a unique modern look while ensuring extra camera and screen protection.

✔ Transparent clear case for iPhone (various models available)
✔ Shockproof pastel bumper with stylish wavy edges
✔ Lightweight, slim-fit & comfortable to hold
✔ Scratch-resistant back to keep your phone looking new
✔ Available in trendy pastel shades – pink, blue, cream, lilac & more

Perfect for those who love a chic, minimal, and protective iPhone case.
